subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — OTEL and Prometheus exporter mappings

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these six AI-safety events as a core and public diagnostics contract, including policy-authorized plugin emissions, or keep safety telemetry plugin-owned?
rationale: The answer determines permanent event names, privacy and cardinality policy, trusted-versus-plugin provenance semantics, and whether new plugin SDK surface is appropriate; code review cannot choose that product boundary safely.

options.title: Internal-first taxonomy
options.body: Approve only core-owned producers and exporter mappings now, preserving trust provenance and deferring all public plugin emission/API surface to a separate decision.

options.title: Approve the full public stack
options.body: Sponsor the four-PR taxonomy, exporter, plugin API, and UI series with an explicit compatibility and security contract plus coordinated landing order.

options.title: Keep safety telemetry plugin-owned
options.body: Decline the new core taxonomy and implement optional safety collection and dashboards through an external diagnostics plugin where current extension seams suffice.

recommendation.title: Internal-first taxonomy
recommendation.body: Approve only core-owned producers and exporter mappings now, preserving trust provenance and deferring all public plugin emission/API surface to a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across the internal diagnostics trust boundary and both exporter implementations.
